meaning: first-order warning from fixed baseline local-peak positions; not exact switch damping or maximum safe extrapolation radius

inputs.p0: P0 at original baseline control time
inputs.g_i: sign(V0(t_i))*Vzeta(t_i),same force units per unit fractional damping
inputs.S_i: -g_i/P0 for every branch; never normalize competitor bypj
inputs.positions: fixed baseline indices/times and peak-selection scope

formula.linear_branches: ell_i(delta)=p_i+g_i*delta while old-sign branch is meaningful
formula.multiple_branches: minimum admissible positive intersection is earliest warning only among retained branches

case_handling.gj_equals_g0: parallel when nonzero gap, no finite first-order crossing
case_handling.gj_less_g0: negative crossing pertains to damping decrease only; do not take its absolute value for a positive warning
case_handling.p0_equals_pj: apply R004 exact-active maximum-g rule; if chosen g0 was lower than gj, correct the right-controller selection, warning is immediate
case_handling.zero_peak_branch: do not evaluate sign(0) as a differentiable absolute branch
case_handling.unresolved_gap_or_slope_difference: mark uncertain using source precision, no huge or infinite safe-radius claim
case_handling.sign_reversal: require linear crossing height positive; true sign/crossing still needs existing waveform/error envelopes
case_handling.peak_drift: actual peak positions/new peaks can change, so fixed-location crossing is a warning only

candidate_action.b_ge_bj: warning triggered; original-peak S alone not usable; use existing full-window T1/T2 and residual interval
candidate_action.b_lt_bj: not triggered for this pair; not a global no-switch guarantee
candidate_action.no_positive_crossing: no first-order positive warning from this pair, not safety clearance
candidate_action.statuses: keep mathematical goal, interval width and peak-region status separate
